sloka: सर्वं तत् खलु मे मोघं यत्तप्तं परमं तपः ।यत् समानो महेन्द्रेण मानुषेणास्मि निर्जितः ।। ६.६०.५ ।।।।
transliteration: sarvaṁ tat khalu me moghaṁ yattaptaṁ paramaṁ tapaḥ ।yat samāno mahendreṇa mānuṣeṇāsmi nirjitaḥ ।। 6.60.5 ।।।।

translations.english: " All the penance which I have done, and the asceticism practised by me equal to Mahendra has become purposeless and defeated."
translations.hindi: भीम पराक्रमी ओर विशालकाय प्रहस्त, राक्षसी सेना के साथ गजता हुआ लङ्का के बाहिर आया
